<｜DSML｜parameter name="sql" string="true">WITH rules AS (
  SELECT ID, card_scheme, is_credit, aci, fixed_amount, rate, intracountry
  FROM fees
  WHERE (length(account_type)=0 OR list_contains(account_type,'R'))
    AND (capture_delay IS NULL OR capture_delay='<3')
    AND (monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR monthly_fraud_level='>8.3%')
    AND (monthly_volume IS NULL OR monthly_volume='100k-1m')
    AND length(merchant_category_code)=0
),
p AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, card_scheme, is_credit, aci,
         CASE WHEN issuing_country=acquirer_country THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS intra,
         eur_amount
  FROM payments
  WHERE merchant='Belles_cookbook_store' AND year=2023 AND day_of_year BETWEEN 213 AND 243
)
SELECT p.psp_reference, p.eur_amount, p.card_scheme, p.is_credit, p.aci, p.intra,
       r.ID, r.fixed_amount, r.rate, r.intracountry
FROM p
JOIN rules r
  ON r.card_scheme=p.card_scheme
 AND (r.is_credit IS NULL OR r.is_credit=p.is_credit)
 AND (length(r.aci)=0 OR list_contains(r.aci, p.aci))
 AND (r.intracountry IS NULL OR r.intracountry = p.intra)
ORDER BY p.psp_reference, r.ID</｜DSML｜parameter>

<｜DSML｜tool_calls>
<｜DSML｜invoke name="execute_sql">
<｜DSML｜parameter name="sql" string="true">WITH matched AS (
  SELECT p.psp_reference, p.eur_amount, f.id, f.fixed_amount, f.rate,
    (CASE WHEN array_length(f.account_type)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN f.capture_delay IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN f.monthly_fraud_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN f.monthly_volume IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN array_length(f.merchant_category_code)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mscore,
    (CASE WHEN f.is_credit IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN array_length(f.aci)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN f.intracountry IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tscore
  FROM payments p
  JOIN fees f ON p.card_scheme = f.card_scheme
    AND (array_length(f.account_type)=0 OR f.account_type IS NULL OR list_contains(f.account_type,'D'))
    AND (f.capture_delay='>5' OR f.capture_delay IS NULL)
    AND (f.monthly_fraud_level='>8.3%' OR f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL)
    AND (f.monthly_volume='100k-1m' OR f.monthly_volume IS NULL)
    AND (array_length(f.merchant_category_code)=0 OR f.merchant_category_code IS NULL)
    AND (f.is_credit = p.is_credit OR f.is_credit IS NULL)
    AND (array_length(f.aci)=0 OR f.aci IS NULL OR list_contains(f.aci, p.aci))
    AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR (f.intracountry=1.0 AND p.issuing_country=p.acquirer_country) OR (f.intracountry=0.0 AND p.issuing_country<>p.acquirer_country))
  WHERE p.merchant='Rafa_AI' AND p.year=2023 AND p.day_of_year BETWEEN 274 AND 304
),
best AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, MAX(mscore) AS mscore, MAX(tscore) AS tscore FROM matched GROUP BY psp_reference
),
one_best AS (
  SELECT m.psp_reference, MIN(m.id) as best_id
  FROM matched m JOIN best b USING (psp_reference)
  WHERE m.mscore=b.mscore AND m.tscore=b.tscore
  GROUP BY m.psp_reference
)
SELECT SUM(m.fixed_amount + m.rate * m.eur_amount / 10000.0) AS total_fee
FROM matched m
JOIN one_best ob USING (psp_reference)
WHERE m.id = ob.best_id</｜DSML｜parameter>
</｜DSML｜invoke>
</｜DSML｜tool_calls>
